title: Performance
outcome: Measure TaskFlow and improve bottlenecks systematically across browser, API, database, cache, and network without sacrificing correctness.
artifact: Before/after performance report with measured bottleneck, change, and regression guard.
labSteps: Choose a user-visible flow and collect a baseline instead of optimizing globally.
Inspect network waterfalls/payloads and frontend rendering for avoidable work.
Measure API endpoint latency with enough context to separate application and database time.
Inspect PostgreSQL EXPLAIN/ANALYZE for a representative slow query and validate index/query changes.
Reduce N+1 or redundant requests before adding caches.
Record the before/after result and add a budget/test where a regression would matter.
failureModes: Caching incorrect data or bypassing authorization
Adding indexes that slow writes without helping real queries
Benchmarking development mode and assuming production behavior
mastery: Can justify performance tradeoffs with measurements
principles: Measure before optimizing so work targets real bottlenecks instead of intuition.
Reduce unnecessary network requests, database queries, rendering work, and payload size before reaching for exotic caching.
Use indexes and query plans when database latency is the bottleneck.
Performance work must preserve correctness, observability, and maintainability.
